description: This file defines a React component for a 'Delete Account' page in a frontend web application. It manages user input for confirming account deletion via password, handles the deletion process through an HTTP request, and provides navigation options. It includes UI elements such as warnings, password input, export data button, and navigation links.

classes.name: DeleteAccount
classes.description: React component enabling users to delete their account with password confirmation.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes component state and binds event handlers.

methods.name: onPasswordChanged
methods.description: Updates state with the new password, marks password as dirty, and checks if invalid.

methods.name: isPasswordInvalid
methods.description: Determines if current password input is invalid based on state.

methods.name: onDeleteInvoked
methods.description: Handles the delete account action by making an HTTP request and processing the response.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the delete account confirmation UI with warnings, password input, and navigation buttons.
